title: Heart Evangelista named 'top celeb voice' at NY Fashion Week by analytics firm
summary: Heart Evangelista emerged as the top celebrity voice at New York Fashion Week’s Spring/Summer 2027 shows, according to fashion analytics company Launchmetrics.
